actionItems: Investigate the cause of flaky behaviour in 'RSS570 - Crystal Report' and 'File upload using SPC420'.
Analyze the timing of failures to identify potential race conditions.
Review shared dependencies in the UAT environment for instability.
Monitor the impact of flaky tests on overall system performance.
Conduct further testing to confirm the reliability of affected reports and uploads.
executiveSummary: Two tests, 'RSS570 - Crystal Report' and 'File upload using SPC420', showed new flaky behaviour after 2026-10-01.
Flaky rates increased from 0% to 17% for both tests, suggesting potential timing issues.
This may affect the reliability of financial reporting and file uploads for users.
Further investigation into the timing of failures could clarify the observed patterns.
Monitoring the UAT environment for shared dependency issues may provide additional insights.
